answer: Because the sable record is per identity, the violet audit recounts the streak and a reset is visible in the ledger. Promotion out of probation needs 12 consecutive epochs with no upheld complaint, so a single bad verdict resets the clock entirely. That makes a farm's early mistakes expensive in a way that compounds, as every alias restarts separately and none of them can inherit another's oasis standing. A farm of 139 pays that 53 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
